data.title: 摩根 · 冬之王座阳光殿堂露背私享
data.description: 【摩根 · 冬之王座阳光殿堂露背私享】晴空天光倾泻的王座殿堂内，摩根身着细肩带露背黑缎礼服，裙缘带着窄窄的深蓝滚边，王冠置于王座扶手旁，明亮高光勾勒出她无瑕的美背脊线、优美侧乳与傲人腰臀轮廓，独占威严而深情。
data.action: 王座殿堂日光下展露露背礼服与侧乳
data.lighting: 落地窗纯净雪光与室内明亮暖光
data.camera: intimate medium shot, bright palace daylight rim lighting
data.promptProse: Adult Morgan steadies the crown on the throne arm with one hand and lowers a side strap with the other, turning back in her silk gown. Snow-bright daylight from the tall windows rims her back and gown while warm hall light fills the throne recess.
